scripts.openapi: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m app.cli.export_openapi && npm --prefix ../frontend run openapi:types
scripts.lint: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check app tests && npm --prefix ../frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m mypy app && npm --prefix ../frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run build
